ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The macro-level ratio is heavily skewed toward low-intensity pixels, with approximately 95% of the visible fluke surface represented by near-black pixel values and 5% by high-intensity white/tan clusters at the tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A single contiguous dark-pixel mass defines the visible fluke body; high-intensity localized pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tip of the left lobe and the trailing edge tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a vertex depth clearly defined against the lighter background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge of the right lobe displays distinct micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude variations; the trailing edge of the left lobe is largely occluded by high-contrast pixel noise from water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe trailing edge follows a convex-to-concave trajectory towards the tip; the left lobe exhibits a pronounced downward convex curve as it enters the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/tan pixel groupings are localized at the distal tips, specifically a dense cluster on the leftmost tip and a trailing-edge alignment on the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular geometric protrusions consistent with calcified bio-fouling are visible at the distal extremities of both lobes, significantly altering the natural linear boundary of the tips.
